provenance.note: Blinded single-subagent adjudication (MERGE-PLAN §2): vendor labels stripped, A/B randomized per file, candidate-pair focus. confirmed_delta promoted only after caller original-span confirmation.

base_member_text: dep and eta must come from the same run/grid for the mask (L36) to align; both are hardcoded workshop paths (L11, L13).
audit_member_text: Portability defect at L9-L13: both dep and eta locations are developer-specific absolute paths despite the instruction to supply one's own path; running elsewhere requires source edits.

base_member_text: mat.rcParams.update (L56) is called inside the loop after most text is drawn; rcParams affect subsequently created elements, so first-panel fonts may differ.
audit_member_text: Ordering defect at L33-L56: the global font-size update occurs after each panel's title/labels/colorbar are created. On a fresh process the first panel uses the prior default while later panels can use size 10, yielding inconsistent typography.

base_member_text: Snapshot-to-hour mapping [2,9] -> ['1','8'] implies a 3600 s output interval, consistent with the MATLAB sibling but not verifiable from this file.

audit_member_text: Cross-array shape assumption at L11-L21 and L35-L40: eta is masked with dep and plotted on dep-derived coordinates without checking matching dimensions.
The independent nfile and hr lists at L23-L24 are indexed by the same num at L34 and L42 but equal lengths are not enforced; changing only nfile can cause an out-of-range hr access.
Matplotlib pcolor at L40 does not specify shading while x/y lengths match eta dimensions; behavior can vary by Matplotlib version between boundary truncation and acceptance with automatic shading.
